title-group.article-title: Article with Figures and Graphics for Parser Testing

sec.title: Results with Figures
sec.p: This section contains various figure examples demonstrating graphic support in JATS 1.4. See Figure 1, Figure 2, and Figure 3.

fig.label: Figure 1

caption.title: Simple Diagram Showing Process Flow
caption.p: This figure demonstrates a basic figure element with a single graphic file. The process flow shows the main steps from input to output.

fig.alt-text: Flow chart showing three boxes connected by arrows: Input → Processing → Output

long-desc.p: A detailed flow chart diagram illustrating the three-stage process. Stage 1 (Input) receives data from external sources. Stage 2 (Processing) applies transformation algorithms. Stage 3 (Output) delivers results to downstream systems.

fig.label: Figure 2

caption.title: Bar Chart of Experimental Results
caption.p: Comparison of treatment groups showing mean values with error bars (±SD). *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01 vs. control.

fig.alt-text: Bar chart showing three groups with increasing values from left to right

fig.label: Figure 3

caption.title: Microscopy Images of Cell Cultures
caption.p: Representative images from three independent experiments. Scale bar: 50 μm. Additional high-resolution images are available in the supplementary materials.

fig.alt-text: Microscopy image showing cellular structures with dark nuclei and lighter cytoplasm
fig.attrib: Images courtesy of the Cellular Imaging Core Facility
